Profiled entity workbench commands

Usage: canon entity <COMMAND>

Commands:
  run                Run the full entity orchestration flow
  prepare            Validate and project profile-mapped observations for entity preparation
  index              Build artifact-backed entity indexes
  block              Generate candidate neighborhoods
  candidate-recall   Evaluate candidate retrieval recall against sealed public gold labels
  alias-withholding  Compile a public alias-withholding execution envelope into a report
  generalization     Compile a strict artifact-backed generalization execution envelope into a report
  evidence           Score typed evidence for candidate pairs
  solve              Solve entity identity assignments from evidence artifacts
  link               Link two row sets through the artifact-backed entity workbench
  audit              Audit an entity result artifact against a suite
  promote            Promote an audited entity result into the registry and escrow sidecars
  apply              Replay accepted entity assignments onto input rows
  explain            Explain one entity row, canonical entity, or escrow entity
  profile            List and initialize built-in entity profile templates
  review             Export and import human adjudication review queues
  help               Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
